title: scissor jack
description: A scissor jack: one screw with opposite threads pulls two side nuts together so four hinged arms fold upright and lift the platform; no car, no handle strength shown

facts.intro: Introduce a recognizable scissor jack: a flat base, four hinged steel arms in a diamond and a flat platform on top, with a red-handled crank at the side. Everything is still and low.
facts.cutaway: A simplified cutaway lifts the side cover to expose the long threaded screw across the middle of the diamond and the two brass nuts at the left and right corners.
facts.drive: Illustrated input force turns the crank. The screw spins, the two brass nuts are pulled toward the centre, and the four arms fold upright so the platform rises.
facts.response: Close-up of the nuts. Each turn pulls them a small, fixed distance inward, so the platform climbs smoothly while the arms keep the same length.
facts.hold: No part moves for this explanation. The weight pushing down on the platform cannot spin the screw back, so the jack stays at its height without anyone holding the crank.
facts.repeat: The crank turns again. The nuts slide further inward, the arms stand steeper and the platform rises higher with each full turn.
facts.limit: The crank turns the other way. The nuts move apart again and the platform lowers a little. Raising and lowering are both just the screw turning.
facts.payoff: The cover closes. Crank, screw, nuts and arms work together: a small turning motion becomes a slow, strong lift. No car or load is shown.

narration_rules.message: only a hand-cranked screw jack is depicted
no car or wheel is shown; speak only of the platform and a load
